entry.description: Compare options across explicit scenarios, then design more than one bounded learning probe. A bridge to apprenticeship duties 8-10. Scenario analysis, sensitivity testing and safe-to-fail probes are distinct activities; none is a guarantee about the future.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.

State what is needed before choosing an option.

Define sensing, dampening and amplification before acting.
